Class DENTAL

java.lang.Object
DENTAL
public class DENTAL extends Object
Records the teeth of the members of one Florida family for the Florida Dental Association. Each tooth is an incisor (I), a bicuspid (B), or a missing tooth (M). The teeth are stored in a three dimensional array of characters: one plane per person, two rows (uppers and lowers), and one column per tooth. After the family is entered, a menu lets the user print the record, extract a tooth, report the root canal indices, or exit.
